text:
Ravi S.: dropped a prototype for Account > Data actions trying to make Archive vs Delete feel distinct and safe. want feedback on validation and confirmation patterns. Hannah B.: Archive should be low-friction: optimistic change + undo toast. Delete = high-friction: modal with typed confirmation for irreversible deletes. Kai N.: Agree on undo for archive. For form validation: inline on blur for obvious fields, show a compact error banner on submit linking to fields. keep error copy short. Priya Rao: microcopy option for delete modal body: "This will permanently remove all data for this account and cannot be restored. Type the account name to confirm deletion." Button: "Delete permanently" (danger). Toni M: accessibility checklist: move focus to the error banner or modal on submit/open, use aria-live="assertive" for the banner on submit, and ensure inputs have aria-invalid + aria-describedby. Toni M.: code snippet suggestion: ```
Enter the account name.
``` Hannah B.: mobile note banner should collapse to a small badge to avoid pushing content. badge can expand inline when tapped. ensure it doesn't obscure form controls. Kai N.: required markers: subtle asterisk visually, plus required for screen readers. reserve error space or animate to prevent layout jumps. Ravi S.: for delete flow variants: 1) single-item delete = modal with typed confirm + explain consequences, 2) bulk deletes = modal + typed confirm + summary of affected items, 3) archive = inline toggle + undo snackbar. will prototype all three. Priya Rao: copy alternatives for undo toast: "Account archived. Undo" vs "Archived. You can undo in 10s" prefer concise. Toni M: when using typed confirm, verify server-side name comparison and provide a helpful error ("Names do not match") with aria-live so it's announced. Also ensure focus returns to typed input on error. Kai N.: analytics: track accidental_delete_rate, undo_rate, time_to_fix_form_errors. we can use these to pick a pattern after A/B test. Ravi S.: i'll mock the banner-badge + modal typed confirm flows and include copy options. will tag UX Writing for final language. thanks! design-bot: created design doc https://redwood/designs/archive-delete-patterns 3 accessibility checklist and suggested metrics to track.
